final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.observstation AS observstation, o.weathprofile AS weather_condition, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation COLLATE BINARY = o.observstation COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.observstation COLLATE BINARY, o.weathprofile COLLATE BINARY), step2 AS (SELECT weather_condition, AVG(group_count) AS avg_group_count FROM step1 GROUP BY weather_condition COLLATE BINARY) SELECT s.observstation, s.weather_condition, s.group_count, s.group_count - a.avg_group_count AS difference FROM step1 AS s JOIN step2 AS a ON s.weather_condition COLLATE BINARY = a.weather_condition COLLATE BINARY WHERE s.group_count > a.avg_group_count ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
